# Vendored workbook parser

`xlsx-0.20.3.tgz` is the unmodified SheetJS Community Edition release from
<https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/xlsx-0.20.3.tgz>, downloaded on 2026-11-10.
The archive contains its upstream license. Its integrity is recorded in
`package-lock.json`; npm installs this local archive without depending on an
outdated npm registry release.

Official installation instructions:
<https://docs.sheetjs.com/docs/getting-started/installation/frameworks/>
